pkgmetadata.longdescription: nchat is a terminal-based (ncurses) chat client for Telegram and WhatsApp, with a Vim/Emacs-friendly UI: chat list and message panes, message history, replies, reactions, file transfers, emoji, and multiple accounts at once. Telegram support uses a bundled copy of the official tdlib; WhatsApp support uses a bundled, patched whatsmeow (Go). Each protocol is a separate library that nchat loads at runtime.

use.flag: Build Telegram support (bundled net-libs/tdlib; a long, memory-hungry build)
Build WhatsApp support (whatsmeow, needs dev-lang/go to build)
